title: Geometry-Driven Conditioning of Multivariate Vandermonde Matrices in High-Degree Regimes
summary: We study multivariate monomial Vandermonde matrices $V_N(Z)$ with arbitrary distinct nodes $Z=\{z_1,\dots,z_s\}\subset B_2^n$ in the high-degree regime $N\ge s-1$.
